notes: §1985:XIV.3.6.4 GR15 applies only "If the ADVANCING phrase is implicitly or explicitly specified and vertical positioning is applicable"; every device here is oriented to variable-length messages (docs/CONFORMANCE.md Communication devices row; McsStore.Transmit), so the antecedent is never true and GR12 has the MCS ignore the phrase. CommunicationBinder.ScreenSendAdvancing still asks the operands' legality: integer identifier-3, mnemonic-name a feature with no LINE/LINES. Probe s1: integer, PAGE, mnemonic and a negative identifier-3 (15b, undefined) each answer 00 and write the message unchanged; a non-integer identifier-3 is refused COBOL6171.

next.reason: 1985: "If the ADVANCING phrase is implicitly or explicitly specified and vertical positioning is applicable"; 2023: "The 2023 SEND statement (14.9.38) is the message-server SEND and has no ADVANCING phrase; the communication module is gone.". The 2023 SEND sends to message server run units and has no ADVANCING phrase. WRITE ADVANCING covers files, not communication devices. The 1985 rule has no counterpart.
